fence_notes: Activation covers reversible, $0, fleet-owned assets only. Level C untouched: no spend, no publishing, no account creation, no money movement, no live trading or betting — every real transaction stays Brandon's individual tap. Financial tooling is PAPER-ONLY permanently under this program (no wallets, no exchange credentials; paper proof never unlocks live execution). Reverse engineering and security auditing touch ONLY Brandon's own artifacts and code (lawful targets only). eBPF never on zane-box (sandbox cannot load it — S1-class hosts only, observe-before-enforce). seL4 BENCHED: no honest near-term workload; revisit only on a named embedded/isolation target. Every phase ends in a receipt; no receipt = the phase did not happen.

phases.BENCHED_seL4: BENCHED at design (2026-10-31) — no honest near-term workload exists (no embedded target for a proved microkernel in Brandon's operations; a QEMU curiosity is synthetic busywork, banned by the program doctrine). phases.P0_local_sweep: IN FLIGHT (running separately, dispatched 2026-10-31 before this queue entry) — verified inventory of what the fleet already has installed/staged; the activation baseline every later phase checks against.
phases.P1_ghidra_queue: Standing reverse-engineering queue on the already-installed Ghidra shelf (local_ghidra: Ghidra + apktool + jadx), host zane-box. Framework: intake (artifact + sha256 + lawful basis = ownership) → fixed analysis passes → findings dossier per artifact. First workload: Aurum 2.1 APK audit pass; then a Ghidra pass inside GHOST-Q-015's verify step for every Watch+Pulse build. Proof: Aurum dossier sha256-matched to the delivered APK.
phases.P2_lineage_pattern: NiFi's provenance idea WITHOUT NiFi (no install — wrong scale): a provenance schema (source + transforms[] + timestamps + content hash) applied inside existing pipelines on zane-box. Order: ACE opportunity registry first, then the training dataset registry, then GHOST queue state changes. Proof: a randomly picked ACE candidate and one training record each trace source→transforms→current state by query alone.
phases.P3_audit_lane: AIxCC-pattern (Atlantis/Buttercup class: scan → prove → patch-verify) run through Cody's lane over GENESIS'S OWN codebases only, money-adjacent services first (Genesis Pay/Vault, Apex invoicing, master runtime). A finding counts only when reproduced (failing test / crash input / concrete path); patches verified by a different lane (builder != verifier); output = verified-findings ledger. Hosts: zane-box (static/triage) + S1 (heavy/fuzz seat when its path is up). The Apex Forge client-audit product shape is future and Brandon-gated — internal activation only here.
phases.P4_quant_bakeoff: DESIGN-PHASE comparison feeding WO-GODTIER-EXECUTION-2026-10-31 stream 3 (StarNet investment engine, paper-only) — NO winner picked in this program. Candidates: Freqtrade / NautilusTrader / ArcticDB / Qlib. Criteria (published score sheet): backtest-to-paper code fidelity, local data-layer fit on S1, Risk Manager veto + three risk laws enforceable in-pipeline, pipeline breadth, operational weight, audit-ledger/lineage compatibility, time-to-first-honest-backtest. Proof: score sheet + one reproducible backtest per finalist on the same dataset. Whatever wins runs the pipeline: market data → backtests → 100-trade paper ledger → MONEY board, under the desk architecture (Trader proposes, Risk Manager vetoes).
phases.P5_ebpf_pilot: eBPF/Tetragon guardrails — Platinum Level A/B/C enforced in the kernel. Host: S1-CLASS ONLY (zane-box sandbox cannot load eBPF, same wall as Docker/setns). Gated on (a) S1 path healthy and (b) a scoped pilot design naming ONE agent workload + rollback. Sequence: observe-mode tracing baseline first, then exactly ONE narrow enforcing policy proven against a violation harness, then a pilot report to Brandon BEFORE any policy touches real agent traffic. Proof: a real blocked violation logged AND zero false-positive kills of legitimate work in the observation window — both halves required.
